source: In the S bus, in the rush hour. A chap of about 26, felt hat with a cord instead of a ribbon, neck too long, as if someone’s been having a tug-of-war with it. People getting off. The chap in question gets annoyed with one of the men standing next to him. He accuses him of jostling him every time anyone goes past. A snivelling tone which is meant to be aggressive. When he sees a vacant seat he throws himself on to it. Two hours later, I meet him in the Cour de Rome, in front of the gare Saint-Lazare. He’s with a friend who’s saying: "You ought to get an extra button put on your overcoat." He shows him where (at the lapels) and why.

In the rush of a line, the conveyor belt hummed softly, moving items along with methodical regularity. The scanner beeped each barcode, while the bagger worked efficiently at the end, preparing for bags to be handed out. Behind, another shopper edged closer, bumping slightly against the divider bar; a small tension flared as they vied for position. 

Nearby, the cashier's screen flickered softly with the total amount announced, followed by prompts for loyalty-card usage. Items in the cart were swiped quickly, the air filled with beeps and short sounds of completion. The register hummed under the rhythmic operations, its efficiency a steady pulse through the moment.

In the background, more shoppers arrived, their carts bumping against each other gently as they maneuvered into place. The cashier turned swiftly to accept payment, while the bagger worked to keep pace with the line's progress. 

As another shopper pushed close, the division between them seemed almost imperceptible. The tension continued, barely simmering beneath the surface of routine. Beeps echoed as more items were added, each one adding to the growing total.

The loyalty-card prompts became increasingly frequent, their gentle insistences a part of the rhythm now. Items moved with practiced speed across the belt, each scan bringing them closer to completion. The line continued to move forward, each item a step in its progress.

Behind the cashier, another customer edged further into the space, their cart scraping against the previous one's divider bar. A quick apology was offered, and the bagger worked diligently to ensure that all items were accounted for accurately. 

The total beeped out again as payment was completed, the loyalty-card screen lighting up with a prompt. The line continued to flow, its rhythm unchanged despite the minor friction of shared space. Each item scanned brought them closer to the end of their retail routine, where another small beep marked their completion and release into the world beyond.

In the rush of the belt, barcodes scanned, items bagged with a steady hum, the cashier guided the line forward efficiently. A cart and divider stood at each stand, awaiting their turn.

Another shopper pressed in from behind, bumping against the back of the current queue. The friction was palpable, a small tension simmering as they both vied for space.

Beeps sounded with each item, the total announced clearly to all ears. Loyalty-card prompts flashed intermittently on the screen, drawing brief glances.

The belt moved steadily, items appearing one by one under the scanner. Each beep added to the rhythm of the line. The cashier’s movements were practiced and steady.

An old card reader clicked and whirred as it processed the loyalty card, prompting the shopper to tap their card again for confirmation. The process was routine but not without its small irritations.

The belt continued, each item scanned and bagged with precise efficiency. The line moved forward methodically, despite the occasional hiccups of impatient shoppers.

A newer model scanner hummed more quietly than the older one nearby, a testament to evolving retail technology. The cashier’s hands worked quickly, each item captured by the machine without delay.

Another item beeped into place, and the total recalculated on the screen. The cashier glanced briefly at the loyalty-card prompts before moving on to the next item in line.

The divider bars were essential, ensuring each cart had its own space. Even as more shoppers arrived, the system kept flowing without too much disruption.

The cashier continued her work, a tapestry of beeps and announcements creating a steady rhythm that spoke of retail’s unchanging routine.

In the bustling checkout line, items clink and clang from a cart, each placed on the conveyor belt. The scanner whirs to life over them with a series of quick beeps; then the bagger reaches through a divider bar to pick up loose items. Behind, another shopper inches closer, barely brushing the cart's edge with his own.

A cashier, engrossed in the register’s routine, taps buttons while the screen announces the total price. A loyalty-card reader waits nearby for swipes and nudges as the line moves forward. The friction of bodies in the narrow queue creates an undercurrent of slight tension, each person vying for a bit more space.

Items pass beneath the scanner; the cash register buzzes with activity. Each beep is punctuated by the sharp intake of breath from shoppers behind the first one. A small divider bar separates them but doesn't alleviate the sense of intrusion as more arrive, their bags pressing against the first person's cart.

The cashier swipes a loyalty card, the prompt buzzing softly before moving on to the next item. A receipt printer whirs quietly in the background, spitting out paper at the end of each transaction. As the line progresses, another customer steps forward, bumping gently into the queue’s rear, causing a momentary pause.

The conveyor belt continues its steady stream of items, while behind it, more shoppers begin to form a new line. The cash register beeps with renewed urgency as the total is calculated and announced again. Loyalty cards are swiped quickly, each transaction moving swiftly but inevitably slower in this crowded space.

Items continue to pile onto the conveyor belt; each beep from the scanner seems to herald another small annoyance among the shoppers. A divider bar provides a physical barrier but not enough to stave off the growing sense of crowding as more people join the line. 

As one transaction concludes, another begins immediately with barely any pause. The beeps and whirs form a continuous backdrop to the retail routine, while behind it, shoppers anxiously wait their turn, adjusting their bags to find just that bit more room.

The belt hummed steadily, barcodes zipping past, while bags flitted through the bagger's nimble hands. The cashier tapped away on her terminal, the scanner whirring in time with the belt’s rhythm. Behind her, a cart sat nestled behind a divider, awaiting its turn.

Another shopper slipped into the line, barely pausing to adjust their position, stirring up slight tension among those already present. The conveyor belt snaked under the barcode reader, beeping each product with precise accuracy. The cashier scanned an item, then another, her movements fluid and practiced.

At last, a receipt fluttered from the machine, crisp and tidy. The shopper accepted it with a brief nod, shuffling forward to claim their bagged goods. Behind them, the conveyer belt carried on, unyielding in its routine.

The register clicked through each item, announcing totals with unwavering authority. The cashier prompted for a loyalty card, but this customer seemed uninterested, reaching into their pocket instead and withdrawing cash. 

The belt continued without pause, each product scanned swiftly and accurately. A second shopper nudged past, barely missing collision with the first’s cart. The conveyor belt whirred on, seamless in its precision.

Another item was added to the growing bag of goods, a process repeated again and again. The cashier’s fingers danced across the keyboard, each scan accompanied by a satisfying beep. The total flashed prominently before her, ready for the shopper's approval.

Behind the line, shoppers waited patiently, occasionally glancing at their watches or rearranging their bags. The belt hummed on, ever forward, punctuated by the occasional beeping of scanned goods. 

The cashier continued to scan, each product contributing to the final sum displayed proudly. A second item joined the bag, its beep adding to the rhythm of retail operations. The total was clearly displayed, ready for payment.

A third shopper moved closer, nearly brushing past those in line. The divide between space and possession grew tenuous as more shoppers took their places. The conveyor belt remained steadfast, each product passing through with precise accuracy.

The cashier continued her work, the belt humming steadily onward. Each item scanned added to the growing total on display. Behind the line, another shopper made their way into position, disrupting the quiet routine just slightly.

At the bustling line, the conveyor belt hummed softly, carrying items towards the scanner. Behind it loomed a small bagging area where the cashier organized bags neatly. She scanned each item with focused attention and placed them into an empty cart, separated by a divider from the next shopper’s belongings.

A second shopper began to push forward impatiently, causing slight friction as their cart bumped into the back of the first person’s cart. The cashier politely asked for patience, but the tension was palpable, hanging in the air like static electricity just before a storm. She swiped her loyalty card and waited for it to be read aloud.

Beeps rang out from the scanners as each item was processed. The total appeared on the screen with a gentle buzz of confirmation. Another beep heralded the cashier’s reminder about points accrual, though both shoppers seemed distracted by the crowded space.

In the bustling queue, cart whispers against divider bar, barcode scanner flashes beeps. Cashier taps receipt for shopper, while another crowds near. Bagging area hums, loyalty-card prompts sound. 

Total appears, displayed briefly before vanishing. Another shopper's cart slides in front, friction evident. Beeps continue as items slide past. Scanner hums softly, card reader lights flicker, waiting.

Cashier taps keys, eyes the crowded queue. Receipt rolls out, printer's whir soft. Shopper moves back, letting another join at cart's edge. Conveyor belt speeds on, steady rhythm maintained.

Beeping grows louder, shopper steps closer to cashier. Scanner hums again, loyalty-card beep signals new prompt. Cashier hands receipt, eyes shifting briefly before returning focus. 

Queue moves slowly forward, each step marked by beeps and scanner whirs. Divider bar clicks as cart slides past, barcode scans swiftly. Shopper takes bagged items, steps back into line.

Beeping slows slightly, cashier turning card over to check loyalty card. Scanner hums quietly, receipt printer chimes softly again. Queue inches forward, steady rhythm maintained throughout.

At the crowded checkout, the belt hummed steadily, items sliding past the scanner with a soft whir. The bagger was busy separating fruits and veggies into plastic bags, while the cashier tapped away on the register, the screen glowing brightly. A shopper behind, pushing their cart with a slight urgency, bumped against the divider bar.

Beeper tones echoed through the store, each one sharp and distinct, signaling the end of another transaction. The cashier announced the total, a familiar ritual: "That comes to $24.75," she said, her voice steady as she prompted for the loyalty card swiped over the reader.

Another shopper pushed forward impatiently, nearly knocking into the cart in front. There was an unspoken tension as they vied for space in the queue. The belt continued its mechanical dance, moving items swiftly to the bagger's station where hands worked deftly. 

The cashier turned back to her keyboard, ready to begin a new transaction. Each time she pressed 'Beep', it marked another item passing under the scanner. She glanced up occasionally at the screen, her eyes darting as they sought to read out each price correctly.

Behind her, the other shopper's voice overlapped with the beeps and whirs of the machine: "Excuse me," they said, "I need my spot." The cashier nodded, an apology hanging in the air. 

In the background, the conveyor belt kept its steady rhythm, a signifier of retail routine. Each beep represented a payment processed, each scan another item accounted for. The queue stretched out before them, a line of items and people moving forward, one by one, through this momentary hold on space and time.

The belt hummed steadily, items nudging each other. The scanner whirred, capturing codes. Behind, a cart lay partially revealed by the divider bar.

Another pushed forward, crowding the line. Tension simmered between shoppers, the air thick with impatience. The cashier nodded sharply, prompting a small friction over space.

Beeps sounded softly, announcing prices, then the total flashed on. Loyalty-card prompts followed, the familiar routine of retail.

Packets slid smoothly onto the belt, stopping just short of colliding. The scanner’s light danced across barcodes, a rhythmic dance.

Behind, the crowd thickened, bodies pressing closer. Words were exchanged briefly, a mix of complaint and understanding.

The cashier turned to the next shopper, beeps punctuating the conversation. The total appeared on the screen, prompting another nod from the customer.

Items moved with precision, each scanned in turn. Behind, the divider bar barely contained the impatience, a thin barrier against encroachment.

Beeps grew louder as more items passed through. A quick glance at the card reader prompted a few words of reassurance to a worried shopper.

The belt carried on, a conveyor of goods. Behind, movement ceased as another customer waited patiently, the queue slowly lengthening.

Beeps faded into the background noise as the register performed its tasks. The cashier's prompt came swiftly, a part of the daily ritual.

In the bustling line, the conveyor belt hummed quietly but steadily, carrying items to the scanner. The shopper, laden with a cart full of groceries, paused momentarily, allowing the divider bar to move forward and let in another customer crowding from behind. A small friction over space arose briefly before both settled into their routine.

The cashier began running items through the machine; each beep added up to the total announced clearly on the screen. The loyalty card reader purred gently as it scanned the shopper's card, offering a discount for previous purchases. 

Numbers flashed by quickly: '8' '6' '7', followed by a soft tone announcing the final amount. The bagging area was almost overflowing; packages were neatly placed in bags while the cashier continued to scan each item with precision.

The second customer, who had been pushed slightly out of line by the first, impatiently jostled forward, nearly bumping into the cart of the person ahead. A brief exchange of looks ensued before both parties moved on with their respective transactions. The divider bar clicked back and forth, marking the end of one checkout session and the beginning of another.

The conveyor belt slowed as it approached the bagging area; items were carefully placed in bags by a dexterous hand, each piece aligned just right. The shopper’s total was announced once more before the cashier paused, glancing at the loyalty card to apply any discounts. A small smile played on her lips as she processed each item with care.

The second customer impatiently waited for their turn, reaching out and nearly touching the items in front of the first shopper's cart. The divider bar slid back, signaling that it was now their turn. Beeps sounded again as they began to run through the line.

The total was announced, prompting the customer to reach into a pocket, pulling out the card reader for their loyalty card. Numbers flashed briefly before the discount applied, bringing the final amount down slightly. Another brief exchange with the cashier followed before they moved on, the divider bar marking the end of yet another checkout session.

Beeps sounded as items were scanned; each beep adding up to the total announced clearly on the screen. The second customer placed their card into the reader, waiting for the discount to be applied. A moment passed while the machine processed and then a soft tone announced the final amount, bringing an end to the transaction.

A small friction over space had arisen briefly, but both customers moved through the line with the register of retail routine: beeps, totals announced, loyalty-card prompts.

In the bustling queue, the conveyor belt hummed steadily, a narrow path for shopping carts to follow. Beside it, the barcode scanner lit up with each item, and the bagging area stood ready. The cashier, a stern figure in a white blouse, watched the divider bar between them and the next customer, while another shopper squeezed closer from behind, their cart bumping softly against the divider.

Beeps echoed softly as the system processed items; soon, the total flashed on a screen, prompting the use of a loyalty card. The first shopper, an elderly woman with a small plastic bag in hand, hesitated as a second pushed past her, clearly impatient for the checkout. 

Behind, the scanner continued its rhythmic clicks, each item adding to the tally. The cashier's voice, calm yet firm, directed the second shopper to wait their turn.

The conveyor belt wound through the narrow space, a steady stream of goods moving towards the bagging area where a helper sorted items into bags. The first customer, still undecided about her loyalty card, looked over at the next in line—another young woman with a large cart full of groceries.

Beeping grew louder as more items came through; the cashier's hand hovered over the screen, ready to input the total for the second shopper. The divider bar stood tall, its purpose clear to all.

The elderly woman finally decided to swipe her card and was soon handed a receipt. As she stepped back, the next in line hurried forward, eager to complete their transaction. 

Behind them, the conveyor belt continued to hum, the barcode scanner's red light flickering on each item. The helper at the bagging area worked quickly, ensuring all items were placed correctly before passing along to the cashier.

Beeps sounded again as the second shopper was called up; they hesitated for a moment before swiping their own card, then collected their receipt from the cashier.
